verdict.rationale: Fellow publishes its own pricing page (fellow.ai/pricing) listing features such as AI meeting summary, transcription, action items, Ask Fellow, keyword tracking, transcript redaction and uploads. Other docs refer to tiers ('paid plan', 'Enterprise-plan'), which implies more than one tier exists. That is only glancing support: none of the evidence shows prices, a free starting tier, which features belong to which tier, or whether basic plans avoid a sales contact. Missing for 10: documented free tier, explicit per-tier prices, per-tier feature mapping, evidence of self-serve signup without a talk-to-sales gate, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start free and see exactly what each paid tier costs and adds — no "talk to sales" wall for basic use

citations.quote: The API is available on any Fellow workspace with a paid plan
Fellow’s Super Admin API lets designated Enterprise‑plan administrators retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace
